overview.text: Today's developments showcase significant releases, academic collaborations, and agent frameworks across the artificial intelligence ecosystem. OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Terra to bring computer use capabilities to users, while also sharing scientific research model results on complex mathematical and physical conjectures with academic communities. In open-source and model releases, HuggingFaceBio introduced Carbon-X, a decoder-only language model trained jointly on DNA sequences and natural-language text. Additionally, research contributions feature RSIHub, a composable framework designed to streamline agent-evolution methods using execution feedback for prompts, skills, and tools. Finally, community discussions and analysis highlighted emerging data, security applications like CodeRabbit utilizing GPT-6.1 Sol, and new evaluation metrics, offering researchers and founders a comprehensive look at current scaling and deployment trends.

entries.title: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
entries.summary: Agent-evolution methods use execution feedback to improve prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration, but their implementations often rebuild the same experimental machinery.
entries.why: RSIHub offers a composable framework to eliminate redundant experimental machinery in agent-evolution research methods.

entries.title: Every Weight Is a Path of Shared Discrete Decisions
entries.summary: We introduce TWIG (Tree-structured Weights with Inherited Gates), a representation in which every weight of a neural network is the end of a path of small discrete decisions: a sign, a shift by a power of two, a zero gate, an index into a shared table.
entries.why: TWIG represents every neural network weight as a path of small discrete decisions for novel architectures.

entries.title: DirCast: Live Esports Directing and Commentary with a Single Streaming Video-Language Model
entries.summary: A live esports broadcast needs a director who chooses which camera goes on air and a caster who talks over that choice, every second and without knowing what comes next.
entries.why: DirCast demonstrates a single streaming video-language model managing live esports directing and commentary tasks.
